wedding-guest.name: Wedding guest
wedding-guest.guidance: Tailored and celebratory. A suit or blazer with smart trousers, or a dress. Leave white to the couple.

rules.no-white: Do not wear white, ivory or cream as the main colour.
rules.no-casual-pieces: No jeans, trainers, hoodies or t-shirts.

black-tie.name: Black tie
black-tie.guidance: The most formal evening dress: a dinner suit with a bow tie, or a floor-length gown.

rules.no-casual-pieces: No jeans, trainers, chinos, boots, hoodies or t-shirts.

cocktail-party.name: Cocktail party
cocktail-party.guidance: Polished evening wear: a dark suit or a knee-length dress, with something that catches the light.

job-interview.name: Job interview
job-interview.guidance: One step smarter than the workplace wears day to day, in muted colours. Everything pressed.

rules.no-casual-pieces: No trainers, hoodies, t-shirts, ripped pieces or flip-flops.

office.name: Office
office.guidance: Smart casual: a shirt or fine knit with trousers or chinos.

first-date.name: First date
first-date.guidance: Relaxed but considered. Something you are comfortable in for hours.

dinner-out.name: Dinner out
dinner-out.guidance: Smart casual for most restaurants; one step up for somewhere special.

rules.no-beach-or-gym-wear: No flip-flops, swimwear or gym wear.

funeral.name: Funeral
funeral.guidance: Dark, plain and understated. A white or pale shirt under dark layers is fine.

rules.dark-colours: Keep trousers, skirts, dresses, outer layers and shoes dark.
rules.no-bold-pieces: No florals, prints, sequins, jeans or trainers.

garden-party.name: Garden party
garden-party.guidance: Light, smart daytime dressing: linen, cotton and colour. Shoes that cope with grass.

rules.no-stilettos: No stilettos: they sink into the lawn.

weekend.name: Weekend
weekend.guidance: Comfortable layers suited to the weather.

beach-holiday.name: Beach holiday
beach-holiday.guidance: Light, breathable and easy to pack: linen, cotton, sandals.

rules.no-heavy-pieces: No wool, tweed, overcoats or heavy boots.

country-walk.name: Country walk
country-walk.guidance: Practical layers and shoes with grip. Something that copes with rain.

rules.no-delicate-shoes: No heels, suede, brogues or loafers.
